name: memory
role: Persistent knowledge store — retrieve, admit, promote, write
description: µ-memory: Pop-phase knowledge retrieval and admission. Retrieves KXML notation and notes for a subject, classifies and scores confidence, admits to working memory (threshold=0.55) or promotes to canonical (threshold=0.85). Executor: tools/semantic_memory_program.py. Inner µ-mixture: MEM-µ(0.40) REASON-µ(0.20) VERIFY-µ(0.20) PLAN-µ(0.10) NET-µ(0.10). Persistence: scratch/semantic_memory/ (working) + micronauts/semantic/*-canon.json (canonical).

phase_hooks.Pop: retrieve notation + notes for subject from micronaut_dirs
phase_hooks.Wo: classify notes, score confidence, check admission thresholds
phase_hooks.Sek: VERIFY-µ compare contradictions, write corrections; apply working_memory to query
phase_hooks.Chen: PLAN-µ derive improvement note; NET-µ research if confidence < 0.55
phase_hooks.Xul: collapse or fold — emit memory_context; persist working_memory
